use default

let ages = MAP()

ages.add("alice", 30)
ages["bob"] = 27

write_line("alice is {ages["alice"]}")

fullSource:
use default

let ages = MAP()

ages.add("alice", 30)
ages["bob"] = 27

write_line("alice is {ages["alice"]}")
write_line("bob is {ages["bob"]}")

let carol = if ages.contains_key("carol") then "known" else "not known" fi

write_line("carol is {carol}")
output:
alice is 30
bob is 27
carol is not known
